title: Test screen freeze fixed
details: Removed the continuous v206 ARP MutationObserver that could freeze Evia when Test opened
Mock-only Discussion and Practical now use short finite checks only when those screens open
Camera and Gallery remain separate choices in mock practical evidence
Course-map recovery remains available without continuously watching the app
Existing evidence, targets, progress, Functional Skills and download behaviour are unchanged
summary: Evia v207 removes the v206 Test-screen freeze and keeps the requested mock-only, camera and course-recovery fixes using finite event-based checks.
changes: Removed the continuous ARP DOM observer
Replaced it with finite event-triggered checks
Forced a clean v207 offline cache
